patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BMC Helix ITSM and HaloITSM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BMC Helix ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/na” rather than HaloITSM's shape. Choose HaloITSM only if your buying job matches “All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onboarding packages extr” rather than BMC Helix ITSM's shape. Workflow advantage differs because BMC Helix ITSM is shaped for Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchang whereas HaloITSM is shaped for All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onbo. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BMC Helix ITSM and HaloITSM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BMC Helix ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/named user/mo. Always RFP. Does not outrank ServiceN; HaloITSM is All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onboarding packages extra. Does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 / Freshservice .
- Company-size focus: BMC Helix ITSM (mid-market, enterprise) vs HaloITSM (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: BMC Helix ITSM — No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; HaloITSM — £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list.

Limitations — BMC Helix ITSM: No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7); HaloITSM: £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list; Onboarding packages stack on the agent SKU.

Poor-fit cases: BMC Helix ITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU · HaloITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: £66 calculator floor is GBP — do not treat as a USD $66 list · Avoid BMC Helix ITSM if you actually need HaloITSM's motion (All-in-one ITSM — first-party UK calculator ~£66/agent/mo annual; onboarding pac)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
